name: summary_judgment.n.01
definition: a judgment rendered by the court prior to a verdict because no material issue of fact exists and one party or the other is entitled to a judgment as a matter of law

name: finding.n.02
definition: the decision of a court on issues of fact or law

name: verdict.n.01
definition: (law) the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a judgment

name: directed_verdict.n.01
definition: a verdict entered by the court in a jury trial without consideration by the jury

name: special_verdict.n.01
definition: a verdict rendered on certain specific factual issues posed by the court without finding for one party or the other

name: compromise_verdict.n.01
definition: a verdict resulting from improper compromises between jurors on material issues

name: general_verdict.n.01
definition: an ordinary verdict declaring which party prevails without any special findings of fact

name: partial_verdict.n.01
definition: (criminal law) a finding that the defendant is guilty of some charges but innocent of others

name: false_verdict.n.01
definition: a manifestly unjust verdict; not true to the evidence

name: finding_of_law.n.01
definition: a finding as to the applicability of a rule of law to particular facts

name: non_prosequitur.n.01
definition: a judgment entered in favor of the defendant when the plaintiff has not continued his action (e.g., has not appeared in court)

name: judgment_on_the_merits.n.01
definition: judgment rendered through analysis and adjudication of the factual issues presented

name: opinion.n.05
definition: the reason for a court's judgment (as opposed to the decision itself)

name: fatwa.n.01
definition: a ruling on a point of Islamic law that is given by a recognized authority

name: affirmation.n.04
definition: a judgment by a higher court that the judgment of a lower court was correct and should stand

name: final_judgment.n.01
definition: a judgment disposing of the case before the court; after the judgment (or an appeal from it) is rendered all that remains is to enforce the judgment

name: conviction.n.02
definition: (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed

name: robbery_conviction.n.01
definition: conviction for robbery

name: rape_conviction.n.01
definition: conviction for rape

name: murder_conviction.n.01
definition: conviction for murder

name: acquittal.n.01
definition: a judgment of not guilty

name: judgment_in_personam.n.01
definition: a judgment rendered against an individual (or corporation) for the payment of money damages

name: arbitration.n.02
definition: the act of deciding as an arbiter; giving authoritative judgment

name: judgment_in_rem.n.01
definition: a judgment pronounced on the status of some particular subject or property or thing (as opposed to one pronounced on persons)

name: default_judgment.n.01
definition: a judgment entered in favor of the plaintiff when the defendant defaults (fails to appear in court)

name: confession_of_judgment.n.01
definition: a judgment entered after a written confession by the debtor without the expense of ordinary legal proceedings

name: eviction.n.02
definition: the expulsion of someone (such as a tenant) from the possession of land by process of law

name: retaliatory_eviction.n.01
definition: an eviction in reprisal for the tenant's good-faith complaints against the landlord; illegal in many states

name: actual_eviction.n.01
definition: the physical ouster of a tenant from the leased premises; the tenant is relieved of any further duty to pay rent

name: ouster.n.02
definition: a wrongful dispossession

name: plea.n.03
definition: an answer indicating why a suit should be dismissed

name: defense.n.11
definition: a defendant's answer or plea denying the truth of the charges against him

name: entrapment.n.01
definition: a defense that claims the defendant would not have broken the law if not tricked into doing it by law enforcement officials

name: presentment.n.01
definition: an accusation of crime made by a grand jury on its own initiative

name: decolonization.n.01
definition: the action of changing from colonial to independent status

name: nonresistance.n.01
definition: group refusal to resort to violence even in defense against violence

name: miracle.n.02
definition: a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent

name: transfiguration.n.02
definition: (New Testament) the sudden emanation of radiance from the person of Jesus

name: assumption.n.05
definition: (Christianity) the taking up of the body and soul of the Virgin Mary when her earthly life had ended

name: makeup.n.02
definition: an event that is substituted for a previously cancelled event

name: consequence.n.01
definition: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

name: knock-on_effect.n.01
definition: a secondary or incidental effect

name: butterfly_effect.n.01
definition: the phenomenon whereby a small change at one place in a complex system can have large effects elsewhere, e.g., a butterfly flapping its wings in Rio de Janeiro might change the weather in Chicago

name: coattails_effect.n.01
definition: (politics) the consequence of one popular candidate in an election drawing votes for other members of the same political party

name: offspring.n.02
definition: something that comes into existence as a result

name: dent.n.01
definition: an appreciable consequence (especially a lessening)

name: aftereffect.n.01
definition: any result that follows its cause after an interval

name: product.n.05
definition: a consequence of someone's efforts or of a particular set of circumstances

name: change.n.04
definition: the result of alteration or modification

name: depolarization.n.01
definition: a loss of polarity or polarization

name: impact.n.02
definition: a forceful consequence; a strong effect

name: bandwagon_effect.n.01
definition: the phenomenon of a popular trend attracting even greater popularity

name: aftermath.n.01
definition: the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)

name: position_effect.n.01
definition: (genetics) the effect on the expression of a gene that is produced by changing its location in a chromosome

name: by-product.n.01
definition: a secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence

name: epiphenomenon.n.01
definition: a secondary phenomenon that is a by-product of another phenomenon

name: domino_effect.n.01
definition: the consequence of one event setting off a chain of similar events (like a falling domino causing a whole row of upended dominos to fall)

name: coriolis_effect.n.01
definition: (physics) an effect whereby a body moving in a rotating frame of reference experiences the Coriolis force acting perpendicular to the direction of motion and to the axis of rotation; on Earth the Coriolis effect deflects moving bodies to the right in the northern hemisphere and to the left in the southern hemisphere

name: response.n.01
definition: a result

name: reaction.n.05
definition: a response that reveals a person's feelings or attitude

name: spillover.n.01
definition: (economics) any indirect effect of public expenditure

name: influence.n.04
definition: the effect of one thing (or person) on another

name: wind.n.02
definition: a tendency or force that influences events

name: perturbation.n.02
definition: (physics) a secondary influence on a system that causes it to deviate slightly

name: variation.n.08
definition: (astronomy) any perturbation of the mean motion or orbit of a planet or satellite (especially a perturbation of the earth's moon)

name: libration.n.01
definition: (astronomy) a real or apparent slow oscillation of a moon or satellite

name: purchase.n.03
definition: a means of exerting influence or gaining advantage

name: harvest.n.02
definition: the consequence of an effort or activity

name: repercussion.n.01
definition: a remote or indirect consequence of some action

name: side_effect.n.02
definition: any adverse and unwanted secondary effect

name: brisance.n.01
definition: the shattering or crushing effect of a sudden release of energy as in an explosion

name: outgrowth.n.01
definition: a natural consequence of development

name: placebo_effect.n.01
definition: any effect that seems to be a consequence of administering a placebo; the change is usually beneficial and is assumed result from the person's faith in the treatment or preconceptions about what the experimental drug was supposed to do; pharmacologists were the first to talk about placebo effects but now the idea has been generalized to many situations having nothing to do with drugs
